name: linear-diffs
title: Linear Diffs
description: Fast Linear Diffs review inbox for pull request status and actions.
author: will_bunting

commands.name: index
commands.title: Linear Diffs
commands.description: Show pull requests from Linear Diffs review notifications.

commands.name: sync
commands.title: Sync Linear Diffs
commands.description: Refresh cached Linear Diffs pull request status in the background.

commands.name: start-sidecar
commands.title: Start Linear Diffs Sidecar
commands.description: Start the local SQLite poller for Linear Diffs.

preferences.name: linearApiKey
preferences.title: Linear API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Personal API key used instead of Sign in with Linear. Required for the local sidecar variant.

preferences.name: pageSize
preferences.title: Notifications to Scan
preferences.description: More rows can find more PRs, but each refresh asks Linear for more notifications.

preferences.name: includeRead
preferences.title: Include Read Notifications
preferences.label: Read Notifications
preferences.description: Disable to show only unread Diffs notifications.

preferences.name: mergeMethod
preferences.title: Merge Method
preferences.description: How pull requests are merged when you merge or enable auto-merge.

preferences.name: deleteBranchOnMerge
preferences.title: Delete Branch on Merge
preferences.label: Delete Source Branch
preferences.description: Delete the source branch after merging.
